document_title: A Study on the Market and Movements of Cryptocurrencies
summary: Master thesis investigating cryptocurrency market movements, diversification benefits, and relationship with Nasdaq 100 index using portfolio strategies, style analysis, and PCA. Finds crypto prices are noisy, move nearly uniformly, and show little clear linear relationship with conventional asset returns.

events.title: Cryptocurrency market moves uniformly with little diversification benefit
events.body: PCA shows cryptocurrency price data is very noisy and currencies move in unison, unlike Nasdaq 100 stocks which have distinct directions. Style analysis suggests no clear linear relationship with conventional assets.
evidence: cryptocurrency price data is very noise and currencies move pretty much in unison
may not be a clear linear relationship between conventional asset returns and those of crypto
